main_text.p: πίστεως, ἢδὲ τῆς ὁμολογίας, ἢδὲ τῆς ἐκκλησιαστικῆς διοικήσεως, ᾧ κανόνῳ, καὶ πίστεως· τὸ ὃ ῥητὸν ἀφ' ὧ λαμβάνοντες τὸ πάσχα κακῶς παρερμηνεύουσιν οἱ προπεπηδημένοι, ἢ ἀγνοοῦντες ἑτέρως ὑπολαμβάνουσιν. Ὁρίζυσι γὰρ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ διαταξει οἱ Απόστολοι, ὅτι ὑμεῖς μὴ ψηφίζητε, ἀλλὰ ποιεῖτε ὅταν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ὑμῶν οἱ ἐκ περιτομῆς, μετ' αὐτῶν ἅμα ποιεῖτε. Audiani vero ad institutum suum quandam ex Apostolorum Constitutione authoritatem accommodant; qui liber tametsi dubia apud multos (τοῖς πολλοῖς, non apud nonnullos, quod habet Petavius) fidei sit, non est tamen improbandus. Nam in eo quæ ad disciplinam Ecclesiæ attinent omnia comprehenduntur; neque quicquam aut in fide ac Catholica professione depravatum, aut Ecclesiæ administrationi, ac decretis contrarium continent. Sed quod ad locum illum attinet, unde suam de Pascha sententiam affirmare conantur, hunc illi perperam interpretantur, & ad alienum sensum per insciitiam traducunt. Etenim Apostoli in illa Constitutione ita definiunt; Vos, inquiunt, temporum rationes ne subducite; sed eo tempore celebrate, quo fratres vestri, qui ex Circumcisione prodierunt. page.notes: The Greek lines at the top of the page run on from the previous page and are set in italic Greek type. Several Greek words are uncertain, notably in the second and third lines (e.g. ἀφ' ὧ, παρερμηνεύουσιν, προπεπηδημένοι), and the accents in the first lines may be misread. The word "disse" at the foot is a catchword for the next page, not part of the text. The text continues on the next page with "dissidelo" from the word "disse".
